desc:
• CLASSIC COOKIE MIX: Create walnut chocolate chip cookies for the whole family to enjoy (Do not eat raw cookie dough)

  • QUICK AND EASY: Just mix, drop, and bake for a chewy, gooey treat any time of the day or night

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare cookie mix as is or explore Betty Crocker recipes for a new take on this classic

  • SPECIAL OCCASION TREATS: Serve walnut chocolate chip cookies for sweet celebrations and everyday moments

  • CONTAINS: One 17.5 oz pouch of Betty Crocker Walnut Chocolate Chip Cookie Mix
features:
Features

Delicious flavor combo: Combines rich semi-sweet chocolate chips with crunchy walnuts for a classic, indulgent cookie experience.

Quick and easy prep: Just add butter and an egg—mix, drop, and bake in minutes.

Convenient size: Comes in a 17.5 oz pouch, yielding around 18–24 cookies per pack

Versatile baking: Great for traditional drop cookies or customizing with extra ingredients like caramel, sea salt, or dried fruits.

Trusted brand: From Betty Crocker—known for consistent quality and delicious results.

No artificial preservatives: Made without artificial preservatives, ensuring a more wholesome treat.  

Benefits

Saves time: Ideal for busy days, last-minute gatherings, or when you need fresh cookies fast.

Homemade taste without the hassle: Get that from-scratch flavor without needing to measure multiple ingredients.

Kid-approved treat: A hit with kids and adults alike—perfect for lunchboxes, parties, or after-dinner desserts.

Easy to personalize: Use as a base to experiment with your favorite mix-ins or cookie sandwich fillings.

Reliable results: Delivers soft, chewy cookies with crunchy walnut texture and melty chocolate in every bite.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Brown Sugar, Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Sugar, Walnut Pieces, Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Nonfat Milk. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
